**Vectoring AI** is a knowledge hub dedicated to making AI accessible to everyone — from curious beginners to seasoned practitioners.

## Content Focus
We publish in-depth tutorials, curated resources, and practical guides covering the most impactful areas of modern AI engineering:

- **Large Language Models (LLMs)** — architectures, fine-tuning, inference optimization, and real-world applications
- **Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)** — indexing, chunking, retrieval strategies, and multimodal RAG
- **AI Agents** — autonomous agents, multi-agent orchestration, tool use, planning, and production deployment
- **Benchmarks** — tracking and analyzing model performance across tasks and domains
- **Milestones** — significant breakthroughs shaping the AI landscape

Our mission is to empower the AI community with practical knowledge and insights that drive innovation and real-world impact.
